summary: Improve how you frame data questions, interpret statistics and read dashboards. Practise a decision template for your role; explore the course.
lede: Data literacy helps non-analysts assess reports and dashboards before using evidence in operational, policy or service decisions. For supervisors, policy officers and functional specialists, the training practises framing decision questions, checking data quality and metric definitions, interpreting statistics and charts, and explaining limitations to inform a role-specific decision template.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for non-analysts who regularly interpret reports, indicators or dashboards and need to use the evidence in operational, policy or service decisions.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace reports, targets or dashboards is useful. No coding or prior data-analysis experience is required.
